Value: OSM building footprints (completeness varies by settlement density)
OpenStreetMap Nigeria via Geofabrik + approved building datasets where available

Step 1: Download Nigeria OSM extract from Geofabrik. Step 2: Extract buildings layer (gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.shp). Step 3: Clip to study area + 5km buffer. Step 4: Validate geometry. Step 5: Remove duplicates. Step 6: Classify building type where OSM tags available. Step 7: Aggregate to community level where individual footprints are too sparse. Step 8: Assign Building_ID.
G29 (flood exposure — building count/area in flood zone), G30 (erosion exposure), G32 (exposure index)

OSM building completeness is highly variable — urban centres (Onitsha, Calabar, Benin City) generally well-mapped; rural communities may have zero or very few digitised footprints. Where OSM building coverage is <20% of estimated community settlement area, flag as data gap and use community population density approach for exposure estimation instead. ODbL attribution mandatory.
